content: The configuration parameter NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_RETRIES [ SWS_NvM_00028 ] shall prescribe the maximum number of write retries for the job of the function NvM_WriteBlock when RAM block data cannot be written successfully to the corresponding NV block.

The configuration parameter NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_RETRIES [ SWS_NvM_00028 ] shall prescribe the maximum number of write retries for the job of the function NvM_WriteBlock when RAM block data cannot be written successfully to the corresponding NV block.

The configuration parameter NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_ RETRIES shall prescribe the maximum number of write retries for the job of the func- tion NvM_WriteBlock when RAM block data cannot be written successfully to the cor- responding NV block (see 10.2.2).

The configuration parameter NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_ RETRIES shall prescribe the maximum number of write retries for the job of the func- tion NvM_WriteBlock when RAM block data cannot be written successfully to the cor- responding NV block.
